gui.quantimium.fold_core.hint: Seat a bound Tesseract to fold, or a Folded Tesseract to unfold.
gui.quantimium.fold_core.fold.tip: Seals the chamber, checks it again, and folds or unfolds it. The socket locks until it's done.
jei.quantimium.fold_chamber.info.frame: The Fold Chamber is a box frame you build round a multiblock: a Fold Pylon on each corner, Fold Rails along the edges, and the Fold Core in the middle of any bottom edge, facing you. Each side is 3 to 17 blocks; the width is odd. A Quantum Foundry takes 9 × 3 × 9.
jei.quantimium.fold_chamber.info.fold: Bind a Tesseract to the machine's controller (sneak-use it), put it in the core and press Fold. The whole box folds into a Folded Tesseract, for 2,000 FE a block.
jei.quantimium.fold_chamber.info.rules: Nothing that holds items, fluid or energy folds, nor anything mid-recipe or unbreakable. The core's screen says what's in the way.
jei.quantimium.folded_tesseract.info.cat: A multiblock folded by a Fold Chamber. In a Quantum Crafter it is a catalyst for everything the machine makes, at a Critical field; a folded Foundry makes the recipes its arms allow.
jei.quantimium.folded_tesseract.info.unf: Unfolds for free, the way it was built, in any Fold Chamber with room for it (the chamber it was folded in doesn't matter), and gives the Tesseract back bound to the controller.

gui.quantimium.fold_core.ready_collapse: Ready to collapse the unbound Tesseract into a Singularity.
